description: Replace Azure Cognitive Search with Vertex AI Search (Discovery Engine) for RAG retrieval and content indexing. This is the core migration: replace the Azure Search SDK with Google Cloud Discovery Engine API calls, update config settings, update the search indexer, content publisher, embedder, and health checks.
steps: Step 1: Update apps/backend/requirements.in - Remove azure-identity, azure-keyvault-secrets, azure-search-documents. Add google-cloud-discoveryengine (the Vertex AI Search / Discovery Engine client library).

Step 2: Rewrite apps/backend/app/services/search/azure_search.py as apps/backend/app/services/search/vertex_search.py - Create a VertexSearchService class that uses the google.cloud.discoveryengine_v1 library to perform search. The service should: (a) Initialize a SearchServiceClient using the same google credentials pattern from vertex_client.py (GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS_JSON), (b) Implement search_context() with the same interface (query, text, user_tier, limit) returning the same dict format [{id, title, content, score, reranker_score, url}], (c) Implement warm_up() method, (d) Keep the existing Redis cache logic, (e) Keep the circuit breaker pattern. Use the Discovery Engine SearchRequest with content_search_spec for extractive answers. The serving config should be configurable via settings.
Step 3: Create apps/backend/app/services/search/__init__.py to export search_service from the new vertex_search module (same singleton pattern).

Step 4: Rewrite apps/backend/app/services/content/search_indexer.py - Replace Azure SearchClient with Discovery Engine DocumentServiceClient for document upserts. The index_knowledge_object() method should create Document objects and use import_documents(). Keep chunk_text() unchanged. Use VERTEX_SEARCH_DATASTORE_ID for the target datastore.

Step 5: Rewrite apps/backend/app/services/content_publisher.py publish_to_azure_search() method - Rename to publish_to_vertex_search(). Use the Discovery Engine DocumentServiceClient to upsert chapter content. Update publish_chapter() to call the renamed method and change the response key from 'azure_search' to 'vertex_search'.

Step 6: Update apps/backend/app/services/ai/embedder.py - The docstring references 'Azure Search built-in vectorization'. Update it to reference Vertex AI Search built-in embedding. The function logic (just returning sanitized text) stays the same since Vertex AI Search also handles embedding internally.

Step 7: Update apps/backend/app/config.py - (a) Remove all Azure config fields: AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID, AZURE_RESOURCE_GROUP, AZURE_CONTAINER_APP_NAME, AZURE_LOG_ANALYTICS_WORKSPACE, KEYVAULT_URL, AZURE_SEARCH_ENDPOINT, AZURE_SEARCH_ADMIN_KEY, AZURE_SEARCH_QUERY_KEY, AZURE_SEARCH_INDEX_NAME, AZURE_SEARCH_SEMANTIC_CONFIG, AZURE_EMBEDDING_MODEL, AZURE_EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS. (b) Add Vertex AI Search fields: VERTEX_SEARCH_DATASTORE_ID (str, default empty), VERTEX_SEARCH_SERVING_CONFIG (str, default 'default_search'), VERTEX_SEARCH_LOCATION (str, default 'global'). (c) Update the validate_production_secrets method to warn about VERTEX_SEARCH_DATASTORE_ID instead of AZURE_SEARCH_ENDPOINT.

Step 8: Update apps/backend/app/api/v1/health.py - Replace azure_search_ping() with vertex_search_ping() that checks the new VertexSearchService. Update deep_health_check to use 'vertex_search' key instead of 'azure_search'.
Step 9: Update apps/backend/app/core/circuit_breaker.py - Rename azure_search_circuit_breaker to vertex_search_circuit_breaker (name='Vertex Search').
Step 10: Update apps/backend/app/main.py - Change the search warm-up import from app.services.search.azure_search to app.services.search.vertex_search. Update the log messages.
Step 11: Update apps/backend/app/services/chat_service.py - Change the import from app.services.search.azure_search to app.services.search.vertex_search.
Step 12: Delete the old apps/backend/app/services/search/azure_search.py file (replaced by vertex_search.py).
acceptance_criteria: No imports from azure.* exist anywhere in apps/backend/app/
apps/backend/app/services/search/vertex_search.py exists with VertexSearchService class implementing search_context() and warm_up()
apps/backend/app/config.py has no AZURE_ prefixed settings (except comments explaining migration)
apps/backend/app/api/v1/health.py checks vertex_search instead of azure_search
The search interface (search_context return format) remains unchanged so chat_service.py continues to work
ruff check apps/backend/app/ passes with no errors
